name: OAuth state parameter missing
description:
The authorization server honoured an authorize request that carried no state parameter. Without state, the client cannot bind the redirect it receives to the flow it initiated: an attacker can begin a flow and deliver the resulting redirect to a victim, binding the attacker's grant to the victim's session (login cross-site request forgery). The finding was proven from the captured exchange: the request carried no state and was answered 302 with a grant.

This row is burpsy's own: Burp's catalogue has no OAuth row; the attack belongs to the cross-site request forgery class, whose row it rides.
remediation: Require the state parameter on every authorize request and reject requests that omit it. Clients must generate an unguessable per-flow state value and verify it on the redirect.

references.title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy: OAuth authentication
